---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation

Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include:
- CLI commands or flags
- Configuration options
- Expected behavior
- Example output

## Alternatives Considered

Are there other ways to achieve the same goal? Why is this approach better?

## Use Case

Describe a concrete scenario where this feature would be useful.

Example:
```bash
dotscrub scan --your-feature-flag ...
```

## Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, or examples that help explain the feature.
